scenes.headline: How M3.1 Flash makes the same model cheaper
scenes.sub: Same backbone as M3, three changes inside.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Mizzen! MiniMax opened the weights of M3.1 Flash. The name sounds small. The files say otherwise.

scenes.text: Flash keeps M3's whole backbone and changes how much memory each token reads: sparse attention everywhere, four-bit experts, a draft head.
scenes.mark: how much memory each token reads
scenes.say: Flash keeps the whole backbone of M3. What changes is how much memory each token reads.

steps.say: A token climbs sixty layers. The first three are dense. The other fifty seven each hold a hundred and twenty eight experts.
A router picks four experts per layer, so about twenty three billion of four hundred and twenty seven billion parameters do the work.
The experts now ship as four bit numbers. The checkpoint drops from about eight hundred and seventy gigabytes to two hundred and fifty.

steps.note: drafts 7 tokens, verified by the model
steps.say: A small draft head guesses seven tokens ahead, and the full model checks them, so the output does not change.

steps.label: Full attention
steps.say: In full attention, every new token reads every past key and value. At a million tokens, that is the slow part.

steps.label: MiniMax Sparse Attention
steps.note: top 16 blocks of 128 per group, plus an index scan
steps.say: Sparse attention scores past blocks with a tiny index and attends exactly to the best sixteen blocks per head group.

steps.label: M3 kept 3 full layers
steps.say: M3 kept three layers on full attention. Flash makes all sixty sparse.

scenes.title: KV read per decoded token at 1M
scenes.note: BF16 cache; storage does not shrink
scenes.say: At a million tokens, plain attention reads about a hundred and twenty nine gigabytes per token. Flash reads about sixteen, but still stores every key and value.

steps.say: MiniMax's own table has Flash leading three of fifteen rows. The newest DeepSeek Flash leads four of the six they share.

scenes.text: Flash is not a smaller model. It is the same model made to read fewer bytes per token.
scenes.say: So Flash is not a smaller model. It is the same model, made to read fewer bytes per token.

recap: Four-bit experts and a draft head
scenes.say: Same backbone. Sparse attention everywhere. Four bit experts and a draft head.
